parsed.name: Modbus TCP客户端
parsed.description: 用于通过 Modbus TCP 协议连接并访问兼容设备的通用通信客户端。它常用于实验室自动化中接入 PLC、远程 I/O、传感器网关、电源或过程控制仪表，以读取线圈、离散输入和寄存器数据，并写入控制命令。
parsed.description_en: A general-purpose communication client for connecting to and accessing Modbus TCP compatible devices. It is commonly used in laboratory automation to interface with PLCs, remote I/O modules, sensor gateways, power supplies, or process instruments, allowing coil, discrete input, and register data to be read and control values to be written.
